about: What a dojo training realm's configuration may and must say. Each file starts as the isolated build's .dist (stock AzerothCore and playerbots values, WotLK rules). 'training' keys are the deliberate differences, each with its reason; 'ordinary' keys must keep their stock value; 'isolation' keys hold this machine's paths, ports and credentials and are checked separately (loopback, dojo ports, dojo schemas). Every other key must equal the .dist, and every .dist key must be present, so no compiled-in default can differ unseen. scripts/dojo/preflight.ps1 enforces this before any start; python -m leeroy_dojo realm provision writes it.

BindIP.why: loopback only; the training realm takes no outside client

MapUpdate.Threads.why: D11: map updates stay on the world thread for the first worker

Console.Enable.why: a hidden process has no console; it is driven through RA on loopback

Ra.Enable.why: the dojo tooling's control channel, bound to a dojo port on loopback

ProcessPriority.why: never raise the training worker above the owner's game

MinWorldUpdateTime.why: at most one world update per 10 ms, the substep D07 fixes for the step driver; at the stock 1 ms an idle worker spends most of a core polling beside the owner's game

Playerbots.MaxRandomBots.why: no random-bot population, and no random-bot accounts are created

Playerbots.AddClassAccountPoolSize.why: no add-class accounts or characters are created

Playerbots.BotCheats.why: no bot cheats: the stock list is food,taxi,raid

Playerbots.WorldBuffMatrix.why: no free world buffs (flasks and food) for bots
